limitations: Real headless Chrome on one desktop, phone-sized viewport is not a phone GPU.

Controls-ready and first observed draw are reproducible cold-load proxies, not Lighthouse interactive/TBT metrics. coldLoad stops at observed first draw; the separately named loadingThroughSampleEnd includes the whole test.
Static localhost server sends uncompressed files with cache disabled. Report actual transfer and decoded bytes; do not present as Internet latency.
RAF and renderer-frame-counter intervals are wall-clock measurements, not GPU timestamps. Adapter list alone does not prove hardware acceleration; glRenderer is recorded separately.

Each version uses its actual default task workload: V3 two carriers; V4 six ships and two dependent missions. V3 mobile defaults to 30Hz; V4 balanced targets 60Hz before measured fallback. Actual canvas dimensions are recorded; no equal-workload, equal-area or equal-FPS speedup claim.
